- On 14 Oct, Ilse posted in #north-team that the renewal is 25 November. I asked her in that thread whether that's an agreed change or a target signing date, and she hasn't replied yet.
- An older CRM note from February says 31 December 2026, which doesn't match either date.

I suggested he check with Ilse before putting 25 November anywhere, and with June too if it turns out to be a contract change. I only shared dates, no prices or discounts, and everything I cited is something Marcus can see himself.
